opportunities.title: RRB NTPC Undergraduate Recruitment 2026
opportunities.qualification_summary: Class 12 (10+2); post-wise conditions and typing requirements apply
eligibility_details: Undergraduate-level NTPC posts: Commercial-cum-Ticket Clerk, Accounts Clerk-cum-Typist, Junior Clerk-cum-Typist and Trains Clerk.
Minimum age 18 years; upper age and category relaxations must be checked in the official CEN 07/2026 notification.
Class 12 qualification and post-specific typing/skill requirements apply.
required_documents: Aadhaar or other accepted identity details; check official instructions
application_steps: Open the official RRB application portal.
Read the detailed notification, confirm eligibility and submit the form before the deadline.
opportunities.source_name: RRB official website and Indian Express report

opportunities.title: Bihar Board Free JEE & NEET Coaching Programme 2027
opportunities.qualification_summary: Students appearing in Class 10 examination in 2027; Class 11 admission under Bihar Board condition applies
opportunities.application_fee: Free coaching programme; confirm portal instructions
eligibility_details: Students appearing for Class 10 examinations in 2027 through BSEB, CBSE, ICSE or another recognised board may apply.
Applicants should intend to pursue Class 11 under a Bihar Board-affiliated school; confirm detailed eligibility on the BSEB portal.
Selection examination is tentatively scheduled for 6 December 2026.
required_documents: Any documents requested by the official application portal
application_steps: Open the official BSEB coaching portal.
Choose the JEE/NEET coaching programme and read the instructions/advertisement.
Complete online registration and save the submitted application receipt.
opportunities.source_name: BSEB official coaching portal; corroborated by Hindustan Times and NDTV

opportunities.title: ONGC Apprentice Engagement 2026–27
opportunities.organization: Oil and Natural Gas Corporation Limited (ONGC)
opportunities.qualification_summary: Trade-wise: 10th/ITI, Diploma or Graduate qualifications; check official vacancy table
eligibility_details: Total 3,047 tentative apprentice seats across ONGC work centres.
Age 18–24 years as on 29 November 2026; category-wise relaxations apply.
Qualification, domicile/work-centre eligibility and application portal depend on the selected trade (NAPS or NATS).
This is an apprenticeship engagement, not a regular permanent job.
required_documents: Educational certificates and marksheets relevant to the selected trade
application_steps: Read the official ONGC advertisement carefully.
For NAPS trades, apply through apprenticeshipindia.gov.in; for NATS trades, apply through nats.education.gov.in.
Choose the correct trade/work centre and submit before the deadline.
